note: Suggestions only. Nothing on this list has been implemented beyond what is already in the build. Each item needs an option chosen by the owner before any change is made. Status for every item: AWAITING YOUR CHOICE.

suggestions.title: Register this site with Associates before adding links

options.label: Register the GitHub Pages URL as a Site, then continue (recommended as the first step)
Keep the links as-is and register later
options.risk: higher; tracking may not attribute correctly

suggestions.why: SRC-02 §1 says Sites must be identified in the application.

suggestions.title: Replace the submitted links with Special Links, after a one-product test

options.label: Test one link end to end (generate Special Link, click, check tracking report), then decide
Replace all five links at once
options.risk: high; the identifiers fail the ASIN check

options.label: Keep the submitted links unchanged until Q01–Q04 are answered

suggestions.why: SRC-02 §2(a)–(b) requires Special Links with the Associates ID. The brief asks for a one-product test before scaling.

suggestions.title: Price and availability display

options.label: Show no prices (current)
Apply for Creators API / PA API access, then show served data with a timestamp
Show only prices Amazon serves through the Special Link itself

suggestions.why: SRC-02 §2(b) limits price display to Amazon-served links or API data.

suggestions.title: Choose a measurement path

options.label: Associates reports only; no site analytics
Owner-hosted endpoint that counts outbound clicks by product, no cookies, no IP storage
options.risk: needs a host; retention must be disclosed

options.label: Third-party analytics with cookies
options.risk: needs cookie disclosure (SRC-02 §3(e)) and consent handling

suggestions.why: GitHub Pages cannot store events. Measurement must be chosen before the five events are defined.

suggestions.title: Publishing cadence for guides

options.label: Two guides per month
One guide per week
One guide every two weeks

suggestions.why: The brief asks for a cadence. Any cadence must still include a source check for each claim.

suggestions.title: Choose which editorial angles to test

options.label: Publish the four working titles from the brief as written
Rewrite titles as checklists tied to listing fields (capacity, cleanup, presets)
Hold until 28 days of Search Console data exists

suggestions.why: The brief calls the titles hypotheses, not evidence of search volume or product superiority.

suggestions.title: Seasonal and topic clusters

options.label: Air-fryer cluster first (three observed listings)
Kitchen-thermometer cluster first (one observed listing)
Defer clusters until the product set is confirmed

suggestions.why: Clusters depend on the confirmed product set (Q01, Q11).

suggestions.title: Imagery

options.label: Typographic design only (current)
Owner-supplied original photos
Generated illustrations, labelled as such

suggestions.why: SRC-02 §6(a) bars altering Program Content, and product photos on Amazon are Program Content. Avoid reusing listing images without permission.

suggestions.title: Brand and authorship

options.label: 'Affil3 editorial desk' (current placeholder)
Named author with a short bio (owner to supply)

suggestions.why: Authorship helps readers judge a source. No author has been invented.

suggestions.title: Where the site is hosted

options.label: Keep static GitHub Pages (current)
Add a small owner-hosted service for the click counter and endpoint

suggestions.why: The click counter and self-hosted analytics need a server (FLG-11).

suggestions.title: Search Console and feed submission

options.label: Owner verifies the Pages URL, then submits the sitemap (recommended)
Defer until the product links are confirmed

suggestions.why: A sitemap and feed are already in place (docs/sitemap.xml, docs/feed.xml).

suggestions.title: Expand the product set through research

options.label: Keep the five submitted products only
Research additional products under owner-approved criteria, with each listing checked against an official Amazon page

suggestions.why: Research must be measured, not guessed. Each added product needs its own confirmation record.
